package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for strings_newreader_on_byte_slice_conversion: `strings.NewReader(string(b))` instead of `bytes.NewReader(b)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario659Positive(b []byte) *strings.Reader {
	return strings.NewReader(string(b))
}
